More on : https://wiki.porchetta.industries/news-2022/indestructible-g0thm0g

## What's Changed
* Compatibility with lsassy v3.1.3 by @Hackndo in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/603
* Added an LDAP checker for Signing AND Channel Binding by @LuemmelSec in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/606
* Hash_spider Module by @pgormanDS in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/528
* Fix subnets module by @snovvcrash in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/609
* Adding shebang and encoding utf-8 for all python files by @wlayzz in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/608
* whoami LDAP module by @spyr0-sec in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/613
* Fix logging with LDAPS protocol by @Dramelac in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/641
* Cmedb export shares by @ILightThings in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/638
* FTP Protocol Addition by @RomanRII in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/639
* LDAP protocol improvements and scan-network module bugfix by @nurfed1 in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/642
* Mssql upload / download by @guervild in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/597
* Add the new daclread.py LDAP module and the msada_guids.py library by @BlWasp in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/610
* Add KeePass discovery module by @d3lb3 in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/636
* Add KeePass trigger abuse module by @d3lb3 in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/637
* Improved cmedb export function by @ILightThings in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/643
* Module to check for NTLMv1 Compatibility by @Tw1sm in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/640
* Module to check for AlwaysInstallElevated by @bogey3 in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/646
* fix(#649) : Fix Wrong filename on RDP screenshot issue by @jdouliez in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/650
* Added functionality to retrieve ssoauthookie from Microsoft Teams local db by @R-Secure in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/647
* Improve CMEDB HELP after loosing too much time with workspace .. by @shoxxdj in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/652
* Update teams_localdb.py to support multi users by @LuemmelSec in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/654
* Add GMSA module by @swisskyrepo in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/614
* Fix regression for mssql with local_auth thx @juliourena by @mpgn in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/658
* Add Masky module by @Z4kSec in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/653
* Fix kerberos authentication by @zblurx in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/655
* Fix #663 - Preventing non admin with access to share folder to READ and WRITE. by @juliourena in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/665
* Added an NLA disabled screenshot function by @lap1nou in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/666
* Add the Impersonate module by @Dfte in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/601
* Fix #668 - Remove @requires_admin flag for WMI queries by @juliourena in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/669
* Bump aardwolf to version 0.2.0 by @mpgn in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/662
* bugfix : cant export csv by @shoxxdj in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/670
* Fix #671 - handlekatz and procdump modules fail  by @juliourena in https://github.com/Porchetta-Industries/CrackMapExec/pull/672

# No Longer Maintained This project is no longer mantained due to the existence of a hostile fork. # CrackMapExec

You are on the **latest up-to-date** repository of the project CrackMapExec ! 🎉 - 🚧 If you want to report a problem, open un [Issue](https://github.com/mpgn/CrackMapExec/issues) - 🔀 If you want to contribute, open a [Pull Request](https://github.com/mpgn/CrackMapExec/pulls) - 💬 If you want to discuss, open a [Discussion](https://github.com/mpgn/CrackMapExec/discussions) # Acknowledgments **(These are the people who did the hard stuff)** This project was originally inspired by: - [CredCrack](https://github.com/gojhonny/CredCrack) - [smbexec](https://github.com/pentestgeek/smbexec) - [smbmap](https://github.com/ShawnDEvans/smbmap) Unintentional contributors: - The [Empire](https://github.com/PowerShellEmpire/Empire) project - @T-S-A's [smbspider](https://github.com/T-S-A/smbspider) script - @ConsciousHacker's partial Python port of Invoke-obfuscation from the [GreatSCT](https://github.com/GreatSCT/GreatSCT) project # Documentation, Tutorials, Examples See the project's [wiki](https://www.crackmapexec.wiki/) for documentation and usage examples # Installation Please see the installation instructions on the [official wiki](https://www.crackmapexec.wiki/getting-started/installation) # Code Contributors Awesome code contributors of CME: [![](https://github.com/Marshall-Hallenbeck.png?size=50)](https://github.com/Marshall-Hallenbeck) [![](https://github.com/zblurx.png?size=50)](https://github.com/zblurx) [![](https://github.com/NeffIsBack.png?size=50)](https://github.com/NeffIsBack) [![](https://github.com/Hackndo.png?size=50)](https://github.com/Hackndo) [![](https://github.com/nurfed1?size=50)](https://github.com/nurfed1) # To do - ~~0wn everything~~
